message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent market data (late 2026), the USD‑GBP rate is roughly **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;=\; \text{£15.60}
\]

So, $20 is approximately **£15.60**.  

> **Note:** Exchange rates vary by source and time. For an exact conversion at the moment you need it, check a reliable financial news site, your bank’s currency converter, or a real‑time API.
